bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
CURRENT=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')
EXPECTED=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-grid-48dccb7 --format '{{.Id}}')
test "$CURRENT" = "$EXPECTED" || { echo GAYBBS_GRID_NOT_CURRENT; exit 51; }
CID=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test -n "$CID" || exit 52
test "$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$EXPECTED" || exit 53
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 54
python3 "$P/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 55
python3 "$P/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" room_private_smoke || exit 56
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 57
echo GAYBBS_TAG_GRID_IMAGE_AND_USERBOT_PASS
